items.quote: the city was calm, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword at the palace.
items.contrast: Athaliah’s death is the cause of the city’s calm; the people’s rejoicing is a parallel outcome, not the stated cause.
items.reason: The explicit word “because” links the city’s calm only to Athaliah being slain, resolving the plausible alternative that the people’s rejoicing caused the calm.
